description: Rule-based known migrations reference dataset for offline fallback and test verification. Not executable code.

proposed_replacement.rationale: Python 3.11+ includes tomllib in standard library (PEP 680), eliminating third-party unmaintained TOML dependencies.

migration_steps.title: Replace import with tomllib
migration_steps.description: Change 'import toml' to 'import tomllib' in config parser files.

migration_steps.title: Use binary file handle for load()
migration_steps.description: tomllib.load requires a binary read mode file descriptor ('rb') rather than taking string paths.
migration_steps.diff_snippet:
-    data = toml.load(path)
+    with open(path, 'rb') as f:
+        data = tomllib.load(f)

migration_steps.title: Remove toml from requirements and pyproject
migration_steps.description: Remove toml specification from requirements.txt and pyproject.toml.

suggested_tests.description: Verify config loader parses settings using tomllib without error.

compatibility_gaps.description: toml.load accepted string paths or text mode; tomllib strictly requires binary mode ('rb').
compatibility_gaps.mitigation: Wrap with 'with open(path, "rb") as f: tomllib.load(f)'.

compatibility_gaps.description: tomllib is read-only and does not implement dump().

open_concerns_and_limitations.title: Minimum Python Version
open_concerns_and_limitations.description: tomllib requires Python >= 3.11. For 3.10 support, tomli must be used conditionally.

proposed_replacement.rationale: platformdirs is the actively maintained, direct community successor to appdirs with exact API parity for user directories.

migration_steps.title: Replace appdirs import with platformdirs
migration_steps.description: Change 'from appdirs import ...' to 'from platformdirs import ...'.
migration_steps.diff_snippet:
-from appdirs import user_cache_dir
+from platformdirs import user_cache_dir

migration_steps.title: Update requirements
migration_steps.description: Replace appdirs with platformdirs in requirements files.

suggested_tests.description: Verify user directory resolution returns existing valid directory path.

compatibility_gaps.description: platformdirs uses modern Apple HIG paths on macOS.
compatibility_gaps.mitigation: Paths are standardized on modern OS defaults.

proposed_replacement.rationale: Jinja2 3.1.x restores compatibility with modern MarkupSafe (>=2.0, 3.x), eliminates the removed soft_unicode import, and supports Python 3.12.

migration_steps.title: Update Jinja2 constraint in requirements.txt
migration_steps.description: Update pinned Jinja2 to >=3.1.2 to resolve soft_unicode incompatibility with MarkupSafe 3.x.

suggested_tests.description: Ensure HTML templates render correctly without soft_unicode ImportError.
suggested_tests.code_snippet:
def test_jinja2_template_rendering():
    from jinja2 import Environment
    env = Environment()
    t = env.from_string('Hello {{ name }}')
    assert t.render(name='World') == 'Hello World'

compatibility_gaps.description: MarkupSafe 2.1.0+ removed soft_unicode; Jinja2 >=3.1.2 uses standard str.
